title: Story objectives count on the tick
caption: Ticking an objective in the Next up story card now moves its count (0/2 to 1/2) right away, not only after the row fades.

title: Ahead in level order
caption: At Lv 1 the Journey card's Ahead list reads Lv 2, Lv 2, Lv 3: the Shop and Closet unlock sits with the other Lv 2 row.
